# Commit Message Guidelines

- Follow the Conventional Commits specification.
- Start with a single-line summary in the imperative mood.
- Limit the first line to 72 characters or fewer.
- Include a commit type such as `feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `docs`, `chore`, `build`, or `ci`.
- Add a scope when it improves clarity.
- Include a concise body explaining what changed and why, not how.
- Describe user-visible behavior changes and side effects.
- Explicitly note breaking changes or required migrations.
- Avoid vague language, filler, and repetition.
- Do not use emojis, mention Copilot, prompts, or the diff.
